c.description:
Welcome to The Arc by Concord Pacific, a modern residential building located at the gateway to Downtown Vancouver and False Creek.

Situated on the 29th floor, this approximately 900 sq. ft. residence offers two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a separate den. The well-designed layout provides comfortable living space, with the den offering flexibility for a home office or additional storage.

The home features contemporary finishes, a kitchen equipped with Miele appliances, marble bathroom finishes, and central air conditioning. It is partially furnished and includes one parking space.

Residents have access to The Arc's Sky Club amenities, including a distinctive glass-bottom swimming pool, fitness centre, sauna, steam room, resident lounge, and 24-hour concierge service.Conveniently located near Cooper's Park, the False Creek Seawall, Yaletown restaurants, grocery stores, public transit, and everyday amenities.
